title: Simplify News header and preserve reader navigation
question: Can the News reader remove redundant header metadata, use compact market navigation, and retain reader state through external article navigation?
hypotheses: A same-tab article link plus a replace-state URL view contract will let browser Back restore the selected reader context without adding history noise.
acceptance_criteria: Selected company pages omit the company-market symbol line and explanatory intro.
Market navigation displays US before TW on both editions.
Article navigation stays in the same tab and browser Back restores stock, range, language and search state.
Responsive News reader remains functional with no horizontal overflow.
evidence: Owner explicitly requests header cleanup, US/TW order, and browser Back usability.
